records.title: The Science of Drugs
records.header: MEDCH 327 The Science of Drugs (3) NSc
records.text: MEDCH 327 The Science of Drugs (3) NSc Introduces students to medicinal chemistry and pharmaceutical sciences. Recommended for students majoring in chemistry, biochemistry, bioengineering, chemical engineering, public health and other health sciences, and related fields. Prerequisite: either CHEM 223, CHEM 237, or CHEM 257; recommended: basic knowledge in general chemistry and organic chemistry. Offered: jointly with PHRMSC 312; Sp.
records.recommendedPreparationText: basic knowledge in general chemistry and organic chemistry.
